competences.description: Attacks the enemy and increases your Attack Bar by 30% if the attack lands as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to decrease their Defense for 2 turns with a 90% chance and inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns with a 90% chance.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Stuns the target and attacks all enemies 3 times to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns on each hit.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
